final: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer AS c JOIN Employee AS e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_averages AS (SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) AS city_average FROM rep_counts GROUP BY City), matched_total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS customer_count FROM rep_counts) SELECT r.City AS city, SUM(r.customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(r.customer_count - a.city_average) AS average_excess, AVG(1.0 * r.customer_count / t.customer_count) AS average_share FROM rep_counts AS r JOIN city_averages AS a ON r.City IS a.City CROSS JOIN matched_total AS t WHERE r.customer_count > a.city_average GROUP BY r.City
